prompt: Create an original 90 second gamelan-inspired instrumental instrumental composition for puzzle game, strategy and patient problem solving. Mood: curious, playful, precise. Instruments: metallophones, soft gong, bamboo flute. Style: cyclic interlocking metallic patterns with long gong punctuation. Tempo approximately 84 BPM; C lydian. Main idea: alternating short and long phrases. Use offset accents and question-and-answer motifs without dramatic shocks. Instrumental only. No vocals, no choir, no humming, no singing, no speech, no lyrics, no vocal samples. Do not imitate any existing artist or melody. [00:00-00:30] Establish the main idea immediately with the core ensemble. [00:30-01:00] Develop the motif with a complementary instrumental counterline, preserving the intended energy. [01:00-01:30] Return to the main idea and give a musically resolved ending with a short natural tail. Finish around 01:30.

description.en: A calm and reflective piece featuring a prominent flute-like wind instrument melody over a gentle piano accompaniment. The music has a flowing, somewhat melancholic feel.
description.zh: 一首平静而沉思的乐曲，以突出的长笛般管乐器旋律为主，配以轻柔的钢琴伴奏。音乐带有一种流畅、略带忧郁的感觉。
